dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, I'm hungry. Where are the restaurants?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, aɪm ˈhʌŋɡri. ˈwɛr ər ðə ˈrɛstərɑːnts?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: They're on the fifth floor. Let's go up!
dialogue.reading: ðɛr ɑːn ðə ˈfɪfθ ˈflɔːr. ˈlɛts ˈɡoʊ ˈʌp!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Over there. But I want bread from the supermarket.
dialogue.reading: ˌoʊvər ˈðɛr. bʌt aɪ ˈwɑːnt ˈbrɛd frəm ðə ˈsuːpərmɑːrkɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It's in the basement. Let's go down, then up!
dialogue.reading: ɪts ɪn ðə ˈbeɪsmənt. ˈlɛts ˈɡoʊ ˈdaʊn, ˈðɛn ˈʌp!
